title: Lección 4 · Irregular Present Subjunctive
source: Expanded practice based on existing SPN 213 Lección 4 subjunctive_lesson.json (stem changers, irregular yo stems); fully irregular forms and additional prompts newly authored.
instructions: Read the English prompt and infinitive/person cue; produce the Spanish sentence before revealing the answer. Click the underlined verb form to request two extra examples of that verb.

fully_irregular.title: Fully irregular · ser, ir, estar, dar, saber, haber
fully_irregular.description: The present-subjunctive forms are not obtained from the usual present indicative yo-stem rule.

yo_stem.title: Irregular yo stems · tenga, haga, ponga…
yo_stem.description: Use the irregular present indicative yo stem to form the subjunctive.

stem_change.title: Stem changers · duerma/durmamos, pida/pidamos…
stem_change.description: Watch the nosotros forms, especially of -ir verbs.
